messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- [decision] Reindex jobs will page on failure. (since 2025-10-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-023)
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. (since 2025-10-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-023)
- [constraint] The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. (since 2025-04-22; source standup/cinder/2025-04-22)

- [decision] As of 2025-12-18, the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. (since 2025-12-18; source standup/atlas/2025-12-18)
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
- The Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. (since 2026-05-27; source standup/atlas/2026-05-27)
- Team Dune observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. (since 2026-06-09; source standup/dune/2026-06-09)
- The Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the indexer's owners. (since 2026-02-10; source standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2)
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. (since 2026-04-01; source handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer)
- [constraint] As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team, taking over from the Atlas team. (since 2026-04-01; source handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer)
  - earlier: [constraint] The indexer is owned by the Atlas team. (held 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; source handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer)
  - earlier: The indexer is owned by the Cinder team. (held 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; source standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2)
- [preference] As of 2026-04-08, for anything Atlas team-related this cycle, page Marcus, not Priya Raman. (since 2026-04-08; source standup/atlas/2026-04-08)
  - earlier: [preference] For anything Atlas team-related, page Priya Raman. (held 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-08; source standup/atlas/2026-03-17)
- [constraint] The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. (since 2025-09-03; source standup/cinder/2025-09-03)
  - earlier: [constraint] The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. (held 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; source standup/cinder/2025-03-17)
- INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24. (since 2025-05-30; source incident-review/INC-2025-011)
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004. (since 2025-02-05; source incident-review/INC-2025-004)
- [decision] As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. (since 2025-07-30; source standup/atlas/2025-07-30)
  - earlier: [decision] As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call. (held 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; source standup/atlas/2025-06-19)
- [constraint] The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. (since 2025-08-25; source standup/atlas/2025-08-25)
- The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches. (since 2025-02-07; source standup/ember/2025-02-07)
- INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. (since 2025-08-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-017)

Question: Why do reindex jobs page on failure?
